diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~50% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.423), which favours a weighted combination.
